title: Beautiful Modern Nashville We-ho Townhouse
description: Beautiful peaceful townhouse only a mile to Broadway and the middle of all the action! Walk to everything and experience the cool new neighborhood We-ho with Soho house, amazing restaurants, breweries, shops, and bars! 3 stories with an amazing rooftop oasis! Gated private parking space and everything you need in the house and more!
